checks.command: node plans/diagnose-implementing/validate-package.mjs plans/diagnose-implementing/app-field-final-closure --strict && pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run lint && pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run test && pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run build && pnpm run guard:foundation
checks.proves: Final package and primary field static/build/foundation gates pass on one SHA.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove native devices, providers, accessibility or independent approvals.
checks.passCriteria: All commands exit zero, field-specific tests really execute and evidence records the final SHA.
checks.failCriteria: Any failure, skipped required field test or different-SHA artifact fails.

checks.command: MANUAL/NATIVE: physical Android and iOS development/release builds; push token/notification cold-warm launch, safe deep links, permissions, camera/document/media, GPS/geofence/mock, offline before/after commit, process death/reboot/update, corrupt queue recovery, assignment revocation, TalkBack/VoiceOver/RTL/large text.
checks.proves: Native field lifecycle, recovery and accessibility work outside static/source assumptions.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not independently approve product, finance, security, release or production deployment.
checks.passCriteria: Every applicable native case passes on builds produced from the final SHA with retained evidence.
checks.failCriteria: Release-only/native lifecycle, permission, offline, accessibility or security failure fails closure.

checks.command: MANUAL/SAME-SHA: using one field actor/partner/store/product, execute U002–U008 outcomes and verify only required control-panel/app-partner/app-client readback after refresh/restart; inspect audit/correlation/log privacy and migration/release SHA identity.
checks.proves: The field operating system converges across exactly its related readers and evidence artifacts identify one SHA.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not make excluded app-captain or unrelated journeys complete.
checks.passCriteria: All required readers converge, excluded surfaces are not dependencies, audit/correlation is diagnosable without sensitive leakage, and all evidence identifies the final SHA.
checks.failCriteria: Stale reader, false success, SHA mismatch, privacy leak, missing audit, migration/release mismatch or scope expansion fails.
